page_title: LEV 5-0 WER | Bayer Leverkusen v Werder Bremen 14/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90' 5 - 0 Goal! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
88' Bayer Leverkusen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
83' 4 - 0 Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a great pass from his teammate and strikes a very powerful shot towards goal that goes inside of the right post!
81' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
80' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes.
77' Xabi Alonso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Granit Xhaka.
77' Substitution. Piero Hincapie will be replaced by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen).
77' That will be all from Leonardo Bittencourt who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Isak Hansen-Aaroen (Werder Bremen).
75' A rebound falls at the feet of Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post.
75' The Werder Bremen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
72' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the right post. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!

71' A pass travels right across the box to Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom left corner, but Michael Zetterer denies him with a decent save.
69' Ole Werner decides to make a substitution. Felix Agu will be replaced by Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen).
69' It's time for a substitution. Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) comes on in place of Nick Woltemade.
68' 3 - 0 Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a quality pass, makes a yard for himself and smashes a jaw-dropping long-range shot into the top of the net. What a remarkable goal!
67' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
65' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a rough foul. Harm Osmers stops the game and makes a call.
65' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
63' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bayer Leverkusen was in an offside position.
63' Close! Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
62' Nathan Tella comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen).
62' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Victor Boniface.
60' 2 - 0 Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a sweet pass and fires the ball inside the left post, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.
59' The referee points to the corner flag and Bayer Leverkusen will take a corner.
58' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Now Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
53' Flag goes up against Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
51' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
49' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
47' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to discuss the decision with Harm Osmers, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
47' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
46' Half-time substitution. Xabi Alonso decided to make a change. Amine Adli is replaced by Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Neat passing move from Bayer Leverkusen in order to create new attacking opportunities.
45+1' PENALTY APPEAL by Werder Bremen, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
44' A lofted cross from Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
43' Harm Osmers blows his whistle after Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
40' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
40' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
38' What a chance that is! Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!
37' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but Michael Zetterer comes off his line to gather the ball.

35' What a great touch by Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
33' Good movement by Felix Agu (Werder Bremen), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
31' A yellow card for a tackle by Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen). Harm Osmers doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
30' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
29' Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
28' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
28' The referee awards a corner and Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take it.

28' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Bayer Leverkusen get a corner.
25' 1 - 0 Goal! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Michael Zetterer.
25' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
24' The Bayer Leverkusen players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

23' There's a break in play and referee Harm Osmers must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bayer Leverkusen using VAR. This could be interesting!
23' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
21' Great teamplay by Werder Bremen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
18' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Harm Osmers blows his whistle for an infringement.
17' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the corner into the box, but Michael Zetterer intercepts it and averts the threat.

17' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Bayer Leverkusen manage to earn a corner.
16' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is flagged for offside.

15' Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Harm Osmers with no other option than to blow for a foul.
14' The resulting corner from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared by the defence.
13' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
11' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
9' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Harm Osmers blows for a foul.

9' Michael Zetterer was forced into action to thwart Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper.
6' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a rough challenge and Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul.
4' The linesman signals that Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
2' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
1' Bayer Leverkusen control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
Harm Osmers is introduced as the referee for today's match.
